title: Gratin Dauphinois
description: Thin slices of potato baked slowly in garlic-scented cream until soft right through and deeply browned on top. No cheese, in the Dauphiné tradition.
notes: It reheats well, so it can be baked a day ahead and warmed through while the meat rests.

steps.text: Slice the potatoes 3 mm thick. Do not rinse them.
steps.tip: The starch on the slices is what thickens the cream. Rinsed potatoes give a watery gratin.

steps.text: Bring the cream, milk, garlic, salt, and nutmeg to a simmer with the potato slices and cook, stirring gently, until the liquid starts to thicken.
Rub a gratin dish with the butter, tip in the potatoes and cream, and level the top.
Bake until deeply browned on top and a knife meets no resistance.
Rest before serving so it sets enough to cut.
